cw_modelman.text: The Model Village is a copy of the village at one-ninth scale, built from local stone in 1937. It has a church, shops, a pub and a river with bridges. Everything is the right size and all of them are wrong.
In the model, there's a model of the model village. Inside that, a model of the model of the model. We've lost count. There may be a lot of them. That's the thing about recursion.
